objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: apat na ugnayan.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: four working relationships.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang isang simpleng katanungan sa bahay-bahay ay kadalasang dumadaan sa mahigit isang ugnayan bago matapos.
sections.takeaway_en: A simple household question usually passes through more than one relationship before it's resolved.

sections.takeaway_fil: Apat na ugnayan ang dumadaan sa BHW — hindi ito nagtatrabaho nang mag-isa.
sections.takeaway_en: Four relationships run through the BHW — the role never works alone.

sections.takeaway_fil: Bago kumilos, tukuyin muna kung anong uri ng suporta ang kailangan — doon mo malalaman kung sino talaga ang lalapitan.
sections.takeaway_en: Before acting, first work out what kind of support is needed — that is how you know who to actually approach.

check.prompt_fil: Sino ang unang lalapitan sa klinikal na alalahanin?
check.prompt_en: Who should you approach first for a clinical concern?

options.fil: Ang midwife o ang itinalagang RHU health professional.
options.en: The midwife or designated RHU health professional.

options.fil: Sinumang may pinakamataas na posisyon kahit walang klinikal na tungkulin.
options.en: Whoever has the highest rank regardless of clinical role.

check.feedback_fil: Ang midwife o ang itinalagang RHU health professional. Ipaliwanag ang dahilan gamit ang sitwasyon sa aralin.
check.feedback_en: The midwife or designated RHU health professional. Explain why using the lesson situation.
